title: Naturality of normalized common-stage evaluation
statement: Let l be prime, Ω an algebraic closure of Q_l, and X a scheme on whose residue fields l is invertible. Use the common-stage category C, tensor T, permitted-pair predicate J, and internal-Hom functor H of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients, def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Let S be partial closed data [def-pod-partial-closed-interfaces] satisfying the finite rational normalization of [def-sf-adic-closed-reindexing-maps]. For permitted pairs P=(M,N), Q=(M′,N′) and any pair arrow g=(v^op,w):P→Q, right evaluation satisfies T(H(g),1_M′) ≫ ev_Q = T(1_H(P),v) ≫ ev_P ≫ w. This is an equation of actual common-stage classes and holds for all pair morphisms, including representatives with denominators.

proof.text: Both S and podCommonClosed satisfy PodCommonTransposeNormalization. Apply the uniqueness clause of podCommonClosed_existsUnique to identify the two entire partial closed structures. Rewrite by that equality, which also identifies their evaluations, and apply normalizedCommonEvaluation_naturality to P, Q and g. No additional hypotheses on the scheme or pair arrow are needed.

lean.statement: theorem normalizedCommonEvaluationForStructure_naturality (S : PodPartialClosed (commonStageDerivedTensor l Ω X) (commonStageHomPairs l Ω X) (commonStageDerivedInternalHom l Ω X)) (hS : PodCommonTransposeNormalization l Ω X S) (P Q : (commonStageHomPairs l Ω X).FullSubcategory) (g : P ⟶ Q) : (commonStageDerivedTensor l Ω X).map (Prod.mkHom ((commonStageDerivedInternalHom l Ω X).map g) (𝟙 Q.obj.1.unop)) ≫ S.evaluation Q = (commonStageDerivedTensor l Ω X).map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 ((commonStageDerivedInternalHom l Ω X).obj P)) g.hom.1.unop) ≫ S.evaluation P ≫ g.hom.2
